HostedSignIn.dc.html.title: Hosted: sign in and workspace switcher

t-local.text: Local dashboard: one container, one port, at /ui

t-hosted.text: Hosted additions: what changes when there are accounts

n-log.text: Live log needs indah: E1 push channel (rows appear within 1 s), E2 table v2 (append-only stream, row renderers), E6 resizable master-detail, E3 collapsible JSON viewer. Also needs semula: a short redacted prompt preview on each call_log row.

n-pending.text: Pending queue needs indah: E1 push (new parked call, count in the rail), E3 multiline editor with JSON mode, E7 dynamic rows (tool-call arguments, stream chunks), E5 toast for validation errors.

n-entries.text: Entries browser needs indah: E2 table v2 (ids not indexes, server paging and filter, cell renderers, multi-select), E4 deep links (/projects/triage/entries/01M5...), E5 badges and switch.

n-entry.text: Entry editor needs indah: E3 code editor with JSON modes and a diff, E5 confirm dialog and toast, E7 dynamic response list, E4 deep link. The version-conflict banner is plain components.

n-review.text: Review queue needs indah: E3 side-by-side word diff (the hardest ask), E5 keyboard shortcuts for approve / reject / next, E2 list with live count, E6 resizable panes.

n-play.text: Playground needs indah: E7 dynamic message stack and tool rows, E3 JSON viewer for the entry preview, E5 switch and tooltip. The tier rail is a custom component: ask indah for E8 theme tokens plus a slot for it.

n-hosted.text: Hosted needs indah H1 identity in context, H2 login with CSRF and Origin checks, H3 roles per workspace, H6 token UI, H7 base-path support. How well these land decides indah versus Svelte + Vite + TypeScript.
